subject.title: fix(onepassword): key pending authorizations by tool call id only

question: Which core contract should guarantee that the 1Password authorization correlation value survives every `before_tool_call` hook and the approval-resolved execution path?
rationale: The plugin cannot preserve a nonce carried in ordinary params against core's last-defined composition behavior, while changing that behavior or adding opaque host metadata affects the shared plugin authorization contract.

options.title: Compose hook params sequentially
options.body: Define each hook's params as the next canonical params value, feed it to subsequent hooks, preserve approval-owner protections, and add multi-hook compatibility tests.

options.title: Add opaque host metadata
options.body: Introduce a separate core-owned invocation metadata channel for authorization correlation that plugins and models cannot replace through ordinary tool params.

options.title: Pause this transport change
options.body: Keep the existing fail-closed behavior while maintainers design the shared authorization-correlation contract separately.

recommendation.title: Compose hook params sequentially
recommendation.body: Define each hook's params as the next canonical params value, feed it to subsequent hooks, preserve approval-owner protections, and add multi-hook compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work is most directly connected to the asynchronous approval and hook-composition contract requiring a decision.
